pages.text: For traveling in mountainous areas where you can fall and crash, you will definitely need a Glider. It is a kind of alternative to the elites, allowing you to smoothly descend down, jumping from high places.
Interesting fact: there is a thrust above the campfire, thanks to which you can take off.

pages.title: Re-inforced paper
pages.text: To create a Glider, Re-inforced paper is needed. You will need it when creating and repairing any airframe.

pages.title: Basic Glider
pages.text: Put it in the breastplate slot, find a high point and, jumping off it, press the space as if it were an elite.
Other gliders differ only in strength.

Any simple glider will burn down in a Nether or from lightning hitting it during a thunderstorm, be careful. To restore it, use the Re-inforced paper that you used for this particular glider on the anvil.
To fly safely in such conditions, you need to add an improvement, again, on the anvil.
